name: jig
description: Minimal scaffolding for prototyping software and firmware with AI agents: every session is a hubnode or a subnode, and each subnode takes one role (spec, bug, work, review, check) at its own settings, with workflows run in order and enforced by jig. init, survey, adopt and update set up a repo and keep it current; stage lands chat-born files; release builds and tags by the repo's own protocol; feedback and fix carry bugs in jig itself back to the jig repo.
